text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is... a racetrack, isn't it? When in 
the world did I—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa...?! Wh-What on earth is this?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My body's making a sound... just like a 
motorcycle engine?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No, more importantly... This is AWESOME!! 
Power is surging through my whole body!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't get what's goin' on, but with 
this! There's no doubt I can run totally 
cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Since we're already at the 
racetrack, I'm gonna take this baby for a 
full-on test driveee!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Uoooooh!! I'm gonna knock it outta the 
park—!!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Vodka! You scared me, suddenly 
jumping out of bed like that!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Scarlet. What about my power? 
How'd the test run go?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... get a grip on yourself. You 
were just having some weird dream anyway, 
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mumbling in her sleep about engines and 
stuff... That's what happens when you lie 
down reading bike catalogs.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A dream... I see. So that was all just a 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, my body remembers that sensation! 
I'm gonna put it straight to work in 
training!

"Through this experience, Vodka's running 
grew even sharper...!"
